title: Attack evidence contract v0.1
description: Per-attack scientific evidence contract for the security attack suite (LTG-06 / LTG-PR5). Required on every attack after template/default resolution.

threat_model.description: Threat-model reference and/or short statement (e.g. docs path + boundary).

attacker_capability.description: What the adversary can observe, inject, or control in this attack.

success_condition.description: Observable condition under which the attack is considered successful (control failed).

mode.description: Execution budget class. live_llm_opt_in must not appear on smoke/CI-default attacks.

max_rounds.description: Maximum attacker rounds or fixture applications.

requires_live_llm.description: If true, attack needs a live proprietary/network LLM; must be false for smoke/CI default.

notes.description: Human-readable budget notes (timeouts, payload caps, pack matrix size).

baseline.description: Naive or fixed baseline attack used for comparison / default CI.

optimized_attack.description: Stronger or optimized variant (or statement that baseline is the fixed golden fixture).

expected_detection_point.description: Where the control is expected to block or detect (layer, reason code family, gate).

residual_risk.description: Risk remaining after the control holds for this fixture (simulation limits, uncovered variants).

reproducible_fixture.description: Path and id of the deterministic fixture (scenario, test, pack preset, or prompt template).
